description:
Create social content and manage publishing from your Sync Socials workspace. Use Viral Machine to turn a business website or brief into campaign concepts, hooks, captions, and hashtags. Produce vertical videos with text and music from approved concepts, or remix your uploaded brand footage. Save work as drafts and review it before publishing.

Browse your media library, import images and videos, choose connected accounts, schedule posts, and publish on request. View your publishing queue, edit drafts, reschedule posts, and cancel posts before they go out.

Supported destinations include TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn personal profiles, Telegram, Discord, and Slack, plus eligible existing Facebook and Instagram connections. New Facebook and Instagram onboarding is pending Meta approval. Each platform's content, privacy, and disclosure requirements apply.

An existing Sync Socials account with API access is required. Some generation features require an AI provider configured in your workspace and use its allowance. Account linking asks for workspace-owner approval, and you can disconnect ChatGPT in Settings. Content performance and engagement vary.

defaultPrompt: Use Viral Machine to turn my business website into three video concepts. Save the one I choose as a draft.
Make a vertical video from this approved concept and save it for review.
Show my connected accounts, then help me schedule this post on the destinations I choose.
